mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies and 78 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School. The moon is currently a waxing crescent, and we expect an overnight low of 68 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Senior Center is currently recruiting volunteers to help support local services. Participants are asked to commit to at least two shifts per month, and please note that some roles require light physical labor and a background check to ensure everyone's safety.

We have a packed schedule starting today with the Dane County Farmers Market, plus live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or take the kids to Girls Try Hockey at the Verona Ice Arena.
In our weekly report, on August 5, police arrested a man on Whalen Road for a probation violation warrant after he attempted to flee from officers.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle. You have plenty of time to enjoy a scoop since the store is open until 10:30 tonight.
